CONSTRUCTION: points allowed come from the joint simulation, so a defence is short the opposing offence by construction. Sacks and takeaways are drawn from the empirical pairs measured within the relevant points-allowed band, which keeps their dependence on the game intact.

EXCLUDED.why: a club's points decompose into offensive touchdowns, kicks, defensive scores and safeties, and only offensive touchdowns are recorded. The others are not separable from the total.
EXCLUDED.bias_direction: every defensive projection here is a FLOOR and is biased DOWNWARD. Defensive scores are also the fattest part of a defence's upside, so the understatement is worst exactly where a tournament cares.
